title: Nice
text: Nice. I do like them a lot. However, they do not wipe clean easily. I had to use shout to get them clean from spots. They are delicate because of the thread work that makes the open border. Not intended for children unless you do like me and put them under a clear table cover for protection.

product_metadata.title: Grelucgo Handcrafted Solid Color Dining Table Runner, Dresser Scarf, Double-Hemstitched (Pink, 14 x 54)
features: Simple design with solid color but looks very delicate; 100% hand-hemstitch instead of machine-hemstitch
Fabric is soft and easy to be clean; no color run after machine or hand washing; just slight steam iron and you can easily get all the wrinkles and creases out
Fabric is NOT thin, so it stays well on the table and does not slide
It’s of very good quality with elegant details
Many colors and sizes choices; can be customized to table runner, placemats, napkins, tablecloth of any size; matching pillow covers also available
description: If you are looking for something simple yet pretty, this will do that all! It is made of nice weight and good material. Choose the right size to décor your nightstand, dressers, servers and tables!
